name: subagent-cli-vscode
description: Render subagent-cli child agent TUIs inside VS Code terminal tabs.

subagent-cli.daemon.port.description: Port the App daemon listens on. The extension uses this as the authoritative port when starting the daemon (passed via --port, overrides config.json).

subagent-cli.cli.path.description: Absolute path to the `subagent-cli` executable. Leave empty to look it up on PATH. When set to an absolute path, its directory is also prepended to PATH in every new VS Code terminal — letting you just type `subagent-cli` and have it resolve to this build (overrides any globally installed copy). Useful for pointing at a local dist build (e.g. /abs/path/subagent-cli/dist/subagent-cli). Reopen existing terminals for the change to take effect.

enumDescriptions: Open the viewer in the system default browser
Open the viewer inside VS Code (webview)
subagent-cli.viewer.browser.description: How to open the Subagent viewer when the status bar button is clicked.

enumDescriptions: Open in the terminal panel area (bottom)
Open as a tab in the editor (document) area
subagent-cli.terminal.location.description: Where subagent session terminals open: the terminal panel, or the editor/document tab area.

scripts.prepackage: node -e "if(+process.versions.node.split('.')[0]<20){console.error('\n[subagent-cli-vscode] Packaging/publishing needs Node >= 20 (vsce deps require global File). Run: nvm use 20\n');process.exit(1)}" && npm run icon
scripts.publish:both: npm run package && vsce publish --packagePath subagent-cli-vscode.vsix && ovsx publish subagent-cli-vscode.vsix
